## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## 🎯 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📸 Mockups/Examples
If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples from other applications.

## 🎨 User Stories
- As a [user type], I want [goal] so that [benefit]
- As a [user type], I want [goal] so that [benefit]

## 📊 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
Any technical details, dependencies, or constraints to consider?

## 📈 Priority
- [ ] High - Critical feature
- [ ] Medium - Important but not urgent
- [ ] Low - Nice to have

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or information about the feature request.

## ✔️ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched for similar feature requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project goals
- [ ] I have provided clear use cases
